Hi Elaine / procurement team —

Thanks for the intro. We're excited to move forward with Polaris Data. To kick off contracting on the MSA + Order Form, could you please send the following so our contracts and security teams can scope redlines and evidence requests: 

- Your most-recent customer-facing MSA (we can work off your version) and the Order Form template (ideally in Word/Excel).
- Primary billing contact (name, email, billing address).
- Any non-standard terms your procurement insists on (e.g., PO-only billing, extended payment terms).
- SOC 2 report or an excerpt (or your vendor portal link) and any data residency requirements.

Our ask from contracts/security side: we'll produce a marked-up redline within 3 business days of receiving your templates, and a short redline summary highlighting ask-critical clauses (liability cap, security, data use, termination).

I've looped in Kimberly (Contracts) and Ben (Legal Ops) — Kimberly will review commercial terms and Ben will maintain the redline tracker. Can we schedule a 30-min kickoff for Wednesday (9/10) afternoon PT to align timelines?

Thanks,

Rachel Kim
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Thanks for the heads-up — I pulled Polaris' MSA and Order Form. Quick notes for internal alignment before the call: 

- Payment/PO: Polaris' 60-day + PO requirement is longer than our standard 30-day terms; we'll propose 45 days as a compromise and add our PO acceptance clause. Flagging for revenue ops if this will impact collections.
- Liability cap: Polaris' current cap is 3x fees or $2M (whichever greater). We typically target 3x fees / $5M for enterprise deals. I'll draft a redline with a fallback of 2x fees / $3M if legal/socialization.
- Data residency: Polaris indicates EMEA customers use EU-only storage; confirm whether this customer requires EU residency (they didn't indicate).
- Security evidence: we'll request SOC 2 Type II, encrypt-at-rest attestation, and the vendor portal audit trail. Ben — please create the redline tracker (I started a CSV in the Drive link).

Target: produce Redwood redline (Word) + summary table by EOD Tuesday 9/9 so Elaine has something to review before the 9/10 call.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference

4) Contract signature: we'll plan for DocuSign once MSA + Exhibit A (Order Form) are finalized.
